limitations: For widths \(n=6k\) with \(k\ge2\), the claim determines only degree \(2k\) rational equivariant homology under the specified \(D_n\times C_2\) action; it does not determine the other nonzero degree, integral lattices, or quotient homotopy type.
scientific_integrity: The arbitrary-width theorem uses published exact matching-extension and ordinary homotopy results and a new natural relative-homology and character argument. Finite code checks are corroboration and do not constitute external or independent validation.
title: Dihedral and layer-exchange modules in lower homology of circular-ladder perfect-matching complexes
